REPORT zosd_ora2_sub.
PARAMETERS p_prog TYPE c LENGTH 40.
DATA lv_r TYPE i.
DATA lv_out TYPE string.
TRY.
    PERFORM f IN PROGRAM (p_prog) USING 21 CHANGING lv_r IF FOUND.
    lv_out = |r{ lv_r }|.
  CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx).
    lv_out = cl_abap_classdescr=>get_class_name( lx ).
ENDTRY.
EXPORT out = lv_out TO MEMORY ID 'ZOSD_ORA2'.
